_description: MariaDB / MySQL: data bind, shared memory for InnoDB temp tables, and a TCP health check on 3306.
_comment: EDIT the data volume path below. Set MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD (or MARIADB_ALLOW_EMPTY_ROOT_PASSWORD / MARIADB_RANDOM_ROOT_PASSWORD) in the container's registry 'env' - LuCI: Configure -> Environment - NOT in this file, which is shared by every mariadb container.
_comment_caps: The entrypoint initialises the data dir and then runs mysqld as the 'mysql' user. Listed so the profile also works with --caps minimal.

_registry._comment_shm: Raise this if you tune the buffer pool high. It is RAM.
_registry.notes: First start initialises the data dir and needs a root-password variable in env. The first initialisation can take a minute - that is what start_period covers.
